title: Facilitator in Microsoft Teams: what does the meeting agent do, and who can switch it off?
summary: The licensing, meeting behaviour and automation are supported by Microsoft Learn. The retention path needs correcting: Learn gives different location-selection page names for Teams chats and OneDrive accounts, but the table gives the Teams route for both.

claims.claim: Disabling IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled turns Facilitator AI-generated meeting notes off for all users.
claims.quote:
You can manage this control using the `IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled` setting in PowerShell.
This means that if you disable this setting, AI-generated notes for meetings is turned off for all users in your organization.

claims.quote: This setting applies to your entire tenant and can't be configured at the user level. This means that if you disable this setting, AI-generated notes for meetings is turned off for all users in your organization.

claims.claim: Facilitator is allowed or blocked in Teams admin center at Teams apps > Manage apps > Facilitator > actions menu > Allow or Block.
claims.quote:
In the left rail navigation, select Teams apps > Manage apps.
In the apps list's search box, search for Facilitator.
Select Facilitator from the app list.
In the actions menu, select Allow or Block.

claims.claim: Update-M365TeamsApp -Id <app id> -IsBlocked <boolean> modifies the app's tenant state.
claims.quote: This cmdlet allows administrators to modify app state, availability and installation status by adding or removing users and groups or changing assignment type or installation status.

claims.claim: App availability is edited in Teams admin center through Manage apps > Facilitator > Users and groups > Availability > Edit availability > Available to, under the stated management heading.
claims.quote:
Select the Users and groups tab.
Under Select to manage who this app is installed for or available to in your organization, select Availability.
Select Edit availability.
Select the required option from Available to menu.

claims.claim: Update-M365TeamsApp -Id <app id> -AppAssignmentType Everyone makes the app available to everyone.
claims.quote:
Update-M365TeamsApp -Id 4c4ec2e8-4a2c-4bce-8d8f-00fc664a4e5b -AppAssignmentType Everyone

Updates the availability value for Bookings app (App ID 4c4ec2e8-4a2c-4bce-8d8f-00fc664a4e5b) to Everyone.

claims.claim: Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true enables Loop components in Teams.
claims.quote: To enable Loop components in Teams, run `Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true`.

claims.claim: Set-SPOTenant -IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled $false disables collaborative meeting notes, which the Facilitator page identifies as its AI-notes control.
claims.quote:
Disable Loop workspace creation and Loop component creation and integration everywhere
[Teams-only] `Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $false`, `Set-SPOTenant -IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled $false`

claims.claim: Meeting transcription is controlled in Teams admin center at Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Transcription.
claims.quote:
In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies.
Select the policy that you want to edit or create a new one.
Toggle Transcription On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowTranscription $true enables meeting transcription for users with that policy.
claims.quote:
To allow specific users in your organization to transcribe, run the following commands:

Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "Your Policy Name" -AllowTranscription $true

claims.claim: The console Take notes button is controlled in Pro Management portal at Rooms > room > Settings > Device > Show Take notes button on the home screen.
claims.quote: In Pro Management portal, select Rooms from the left navigation > select your desired room > Settings > Device > Show Take notes button on the home screen.

claims.claim: The retention path uses Choose locations to apply the policy for both Teams chats interactions and OneDrive accounts notes.
claims.quote:
If you chose Static: On the Choose locations to apply the policy page, select one or more locations:

Retention policy for all other services:
If you chose Static: On the Choose locations page, toggle on or off any of the locations
claims.fix: Replace controls[6].ui.path and its rendered path with 'Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention policies > New retention policy > Choose the type of retention policy to create > Static > Choose locations to apply the policy (Teams chats) or Choose locations (OneDrive accounts) > location'. Learn documents the two location-page labels separately at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/create-retention-policies.

claims.claim: New-RetentionComplianceRule -Policy <policy name> -RetentionDuration <days> -RetentionComplianceAction <Keep, Delete or KeepAndDelete> sets a retention rule's duration and action.
claims.quote:
The RetentionComplianceAction parameter specifies the retention action for the rule. Valid values are:
- Delete
- Keep
- KeepAndDelete

The RetentionDuration parameter specifies the hold duration for the retention rule.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents no admin UI equivalent for the IsLoopEnabled Teams-component control.
claims.quote: Searched: "IsLoopEnabled" "admin center" UI Loop Teams; opened loop-admin-configuration, including its admin-center, Cloud Policy and Teams sections. The UI checkbox controls Loop workspaces, not IsLoopEnabled; the Teams control is PowerShell.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents no admin UI equivalent for IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled.
claims.quote: Searched: "IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled" admin UI; opened loop-admin-configuration and facilitator-teams. The property is managed in PowerShell. The documented New Calendar Cloud Policy is a different control, not a UI for this property.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents no automation call for the Teams Rooms console Take notes button.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms "Show Take notes" PowerShell XML configuration; Facilitator "Show Take notes" Graph API PowerShell. Read facilitator-teams-rooms and new-teams-rooms-feature-not-available: Tap to take notes will not be added as an XML setting; no call found.
